segments.ja293:1.1: Phuṭṭhassa me aññatarena byādhinā, rogena bāḷhaṃ dukhitassa ruppato;
segments.ja293:1.3: Parisussati khippamidaṃ kaḷevaraṃ, pupphaṃ yathā paṃsuni ātape kataṃ.
segments.ja293:3.1: Dhiratthumaṃ āturaṃ pūtikāyaṃ, jegucchiyaṃ assuciṃ byādhidhammaṃ;
segments.ja293:3.3: Yatthappamattā adhimucchitā pajā, hāpenti maggaṃ sugatūpapattiyāti.
